scope: Analytical 0D constant-stress model capability; not native MPM measurements or laboratory data
formulaAfterResidual: kappa_dot=(q-Yr)/eta for fixed q and constant eta
interpretation: Softening increases the 0D rate until residual strength; afterward constant stress/viscosity gives secondary creep. More time alone does not guarantee a failure transition. Full-slope geometry and stress redistribution can still change rates.
nextStep: Review mechanism and localization/activation assumptions before changing parameters or running beyond the authorized120s.
